if(HAVE_ICET)
    # We need to link with OpenGL on Mac when we have IceT.
    if(APPLE)
        set(ICET_OPENGL ${OPENGL_gl_LIBRARY})
    endif()
    # Link icet libraries
    set(ICET_LIBS icet ${ICET_OPENGL})
endif()


set(Volume_DEFINES)
if(VISIT_SLIVR)
    list(APPEND Volume_DEFINES VISIT_SLIVR)
endif()

if(HAVE_ICET)
    set(Volume_ELibs ${ICET_LIBS})
endif()

visit_add_plot_plugin(
    PNAME      Volume
    VSRC       avtVolumeRenderer.C
               avtLowerResolutionVolumeFilter.C
               avtVisItVTKRenderer.C
               avtVisItVTKRenderFilter.C
               avtICETCompositor.C

               avtLowerResolutionVolumeFilter.C
               avtVisItVTKRenderer.C
               avtVisItVTKRenderFilter.C
               avtICETCompositor.C
               avtVolumeResampleFilter.C
    DEFINES    ${Volume_DEFINES}
    VLIBS      VTK::RenderingVolumeOpenGL2
    ESERLIBS   avtexpressions_ser
               avtfilters_ser
               VTK::RenderingVolumeOpenGL2
               ${Volume_ELibs}
    EPARLIBS   avtexpressions_par
               avtfilters_par
               VTK::RenderingVolumeOpenGL2
               ${Volume_ELibs})
